svg.text: Reconstruction logit geometry vs. CE temperature
Converged [mem] embedding, final stage, 50 PG19 samples per run · 42 runs (3 models × 7 temperatures × arms)
raw winning logit over T; spans ~10×
softmax(z/T) mass on the winner; near-flat
argmax convergence keeps every crammed token on top at every T
(z_true − runner-up)/T; flat for T ≳ 0.5, floor rises when cold
change from 10k to 50k steps/sample, averaged over T = 0.1/0.25/0.5
5× more steps buys ~12% more crammed tokens — and no extra per-token confidence.

Takeaway: temperature rescales logit separation, not the solution. The unnormalized top-1 fans out ~10× purely because the pedestal is T-independent; normalized, every model stays a near-deterministic argmax.
